scope: Native diagnostic whole-process CPU/wall including fixture setup and priming; not device timing. Uninstrumented System allocator; no perf process in timed windows.

launches.prior_launch: plain-launch.json rejected leading-dash option argument before any window; retained

classification_rule: Existing native-screen rule: W is max((max-min)/median) across the two CPU-time samples. Improvement requires change<-W and at least4/5 improving pairs; regression requires change>W and at most1/5; otherwise indistinguishable. Not the deployment acceptance gate.
recommendation: Eligible for integration into F and full acceptance; no SDK/on-device benefit or compatibility gate claimed by this native diagnostic.
